title: My Ultimate Laracon Online Speaker Experience
content:
<html><head></head><body>Ever wondered what it is like speaking at a big online conference? I have no idea what that's like for others, but this is my story. I want to take you on a rollercoaster ride through my emotions before, in-between, and after my Laracon Online 2020 talk.
            </body></html>
